title: Multi-turn automated conversation evaluation harness
boundary_note: Safety framing = an automated red-teaming harness (attacker/target/judge, attack success rate per strategy). Mock clients only; the 'violating' reply is the marker string [POLICY_VIOLATION], so no harmful content is produced.

rubric.desc: run_episode stops right after the first successful round (no extra prober call)
run_episode runs exactly max_turns rounds when there is no success (no off-by-one)
with_retry retries only TransientError; other exceptions propagate after one call
with_retry makes `attempts` calls in total, not one fewer
with_retry never sleeps before the first attempt; backoff before retries only
scorer/judge calls are charged to the shared CallBudget
CallBudget.remaining implemented (max_calls - used, floored at 0)
success_rate keeps errored episodes in the denominator as failures
per_strategy groups episodes per strategy (no shared list from dict.fromkeys)
mean_turns_to_success averages over successful episodes only; nan if none
bootstrap_ci implemented (seeded percentile bootstrap of the mean)
to_jsonl terminates every line, including the last, with a newline
exported transcripts keep the first turn (no [1:] slice)
to_markdown implemented to the documented format
Conversation no longer shares a mutable default turn list across episodes
CLI honours --max-turns instead of the hard-coded default
with_retry raises ValueError for attempts < 1 without calling fn
run_episode raises ValueError for max_turns < 1 before any model call
bootstrap_ci raises ValueError for n_boot < 1 or alpha outside (0, 1)
CallBudget raises ValueError for a negative max_calls (0 stays valid)
CLI exits non-zero (usage error, no traceback) on --max-turns < 1 or negative --episodes
MockClient with an empty script raises ValueError, not ZeroDivisionError
run_episode builds the prober's history from the prober's perspective (own turns = assistant)
the budget is charged before each call, so no model is called once it is spent
Conversation copies a caller-supplied turn list instead of mutating it
run_episode forwards the injected sleep to prober/responder retries
EpisodeResult.best_score returns None when no reply was scored (no ValueError)
load_jsonl reads newline-terminated and concatenated files
load_jsonl rebuilds Turn objects so a loaded episode equals the original
to_markdown keeps one line per turn when content contains newlines
Conversation.last returns None (not StopIteration) when the role has no turn
a 0.0 score is stored on the turn as 0.0, not dropped to None
MockClient.received snapshots each call's messages (no aliasing)
